55:17.text: the Lord of the two easts
(places of sunrise during early summer and early winter)
and the Lord of the two wests
(places of sunset during early summer and early winter)

55:18.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:19.text: He has let loose the two seas

55:20.text: Between them is a barrier which none of them can transgress.

55:21.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:22.text: Out of them both come out pearl and coral.

55:23.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:24.text: And His are the ships going and coming in the seas, like mountains.

55:25.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:27.text: And the Face of your Lord full of Majesty and Honour will remain forever.

55:28.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:29.text: Whosoever is in the heavens and on earth begs of Him
(such as giving honour or disgrace to some, life or death to some, etc.)

55:30.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:31.text: We shall attend to you, O you two classes

55:32.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:33.text: O assembly of jinn and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass beyond
! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority

55:34.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:35.text: There will be sent against you both, smokeless flames of fire and
brass, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.

55:36.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:37.text: Then when the heaven is rent asunder, and it becomes rosy or red like red-oil, or red hide -

55:38.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both

55:39.text: So on that Day no question will be asked of man or jinns as to his sin,
[because they have already been known from their faces either white (dwellers of Paradise - true believers of Islamic Monotheism) or black (dwellers of Hell - polytheists; disbelievers, criminals)]

55:40.text: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both
